dz: 英国女王安妮·博林因叛国罪、通奸罪和乱伦罪在伦敦受审；她被专门挑选的陪审团判处死刑。
de: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, stands trial in London on charges of treason, adultery and incest; she is condemned to death by a specially-selected jury.

t: 英国教会向英格兰国王呈递了一次集会,会上放弃了一些权利,例如使省教会的法律独立于国王.
te: The English church submits to the king of England in passing a convocation in which it surrenders a number of rights, s…
dz: 英国教会向英格兰国王呈递了一次集会,会上放弃了一些权利,例如使省教会的法律独立于国王.
de: The English church submits to the king of England in passing a convocation in which it surrenders a number of rights, such as to make provincial ecclesiastic laws independently of the king.

dz: 由Anbaptist牧师托马斯·明策所领导的起义农民在弗兰肯豪森战役被击败,结束了神圣罗马帝国的德意志农民战争.
de: Insurgent peasants led by Anabaptist pastor Thomas Müntzer are defeated at the Battle of Frankenhausen, ending the German Peasants' War in the Holy Roman Empire.

dz: 教皇英诺森四世颁布了教皇训令 ad extipanda，授权但也限制了中世纪宗教裁判所对异端分子的酷刑。
de: Pope Innocent IV issues the papal bull ad extirpanda, which authorizes, but also limits, the torture of heretics in the Medieval Inquisition.

t: 叙利亚人迈克尔对摩尔·巴尔·萨乌马修道院进行再造,他在被大火摧毁后重建了该修道院. 该修道院一…
te: Michael the Syrian reconsecrates the Mor Bar Sauma Monastery, which he reconstructed after its destruction by a fire. T…
dz: 叙利亚人迈克尔对摩尔·巴尔·萨乌马修道院进行再造,他在被大火摧毁后重建了该修道院. 该修道院一直作为叙利亚正教会的中心,直到13世纪末.
de: Michael the Syrian reconsecrates the Mor Bar Sauma Monastery, which he reconstructed after its destruction by a fire. The monastery stays a center of the Syriac Orthodox Church until the end of the thirteenth century.

t: 君士坦丁七世被加冕为拜占庭同仁.
te: Constantine VII is crowned Byzantine co-emperor.
dz: 君士坦丁七世被加冕为拜占庭同仁.
de: Constantine VII is crowned Byzantine co-emperor.

dz: Abd al-Rahman一世是统治了伊伯利亚大部近三个世纪的阿拉伯王朝的建立者,他成为了西班牙克多瓦的埃米尔.
de: Abd al-Rahman I, the founder of the Arab dynasty that ruled the greater part of Iberia for nearly three centuries, becomes emir of Cordova, Spain.

dz: 奥塔里国王与巴伐利亚公爵加里布尔德一世之女西奥德琳达结婚,她是一个天主教徒,在伦巴第贵族中有很大的影响.
de: King Authari marries Theodelinda, daughter of the Bavarian duke Garibald I. A Catholic, she has great influence among the Lombard nobility.

t: 瓦伦丁尼安二世皇帝在进军高卢对抗法兰克篡位者阿博加斯特时被暗杀。他被发现吊死在维埃纳的住所中。

dz: 瓦伦丁尼安二世皇帝在进军高卢对抗法兰克篡位者阿博加斯特时被暗杀。他被发现吊死在维埃纳的住所中。
de: Emperor Valentinian II is assassinated while advancing into Gaul against the Frankish usurper Arbogast. He is found hanging in his residence at Vienne.

dz: 刘备,中国军阀,自称舒汉皇帝,汉朝后人.
de: Liu Bei, Chinese warlord, proclaims himself emperor of Shu Han, the successor of the Han dynasty.
